description: Test results including pass, fail, inconclusive and not_run states.
data_classification: SIMULATED ENTERPRISE ARTEFACT - not OEM, customer or proprietary data

records.measured_summary: Power derate observed at 47 minutes; maximum cell temperature reached the protection threshold.
records.deviation: Derate onset 28 minutes earlier than the acceptance condition
records.notes: Ambient 41 degC, cabin cooling at maximum. Concurrent cabin and battery cooling demand suspected.

records.measured_summary: Power derate observed at 52 minutes; maximum cell temperature within 2 K of the protection threshold.
records.deviation: Derate onset 23 minutes earlier than the acceptance condition
records.notes: Ambient 38 degC. Repeat of the same behaviour on the standard range variant.

records.measured_summary: Battery temperature exceeded the operating window at 63 minutes under concurrent maximum cabin cooling demand.
records.notes: Chiller capacity shared between cabin and battery loads. Strongest available evidence for the arbitration hypothesis.

records.measured_summary: Arbitration followed the defined priority scheme in all simulated scenarios.
records.notes: Arbitration behaves as specified. Indicates the specification itself, not the implementation, is the concern.

records.measured_summary: Heat rejection met the specified value at the reference coolant inlet temperature and flow rate.
records.notes: Bench result obtained at 25 degC coolant inlet. No data at elevated coolant inlet temperature.

records.measured_summary: Charge time 10 to 80 percent measured at 43 minutes at 8 degC ambient.
records.deviation: No acceptance criterion established for low ambient
records.notes: Result cannot be judged. Acceptance criterion is TBD_PROGRAMME_SPECIFIC.

records.measured_summary: Charge time 10 to 80 percent measured at 30.5 minutes at 25 degC ambient.
records.notes: Reference condition target met.

records.measured_summary: Measured current ramp rate exceeded the defined limit during derate onset.
records.deviation: Ramp rate above the defined limit
records.notes: Correlates with the station-side session terminations reported in the field.

records.measured_summary: Sessions completed on 34 of 40 stations; 6 terminated above 70 percent state of charge.
records.deviation: No station population coverage or pass rate target established
records.notes: Acceptance criterion is TBD_PROGRAMME_SPECIFIC. Cannot be declared pass or fail.
Test cannot be executed. The current design has no charge inlet contact temperature measurement. This is the gap that ECR-008 addresses.

records.measured_summary: Radiated emissions exceeded the limit in the 76 to 108 MHz band during DC charging on 2 of 6 runs.
records.notes: Intermittent. Not reproducible on every run, which is itself diagnostic.

records.measured_summary: Shield termination impedance above the specified limit at the rear subframe pass-through termination.
records.deviation: Impedance above limit at one termination
records.notes: The failing termination is on the section re-routed by ECR-007.

records.measured_summary: Measured separation from the antenna feed was below the minimum at two locations on the re-routed section.
records.deviation: Separation below minimum at two locations
records.notes: Directly links the routing change to the emissions result.

records.measured_summary: Radial stiffness on the incoming batch measured below the lower specification limit on 17 of 20 samples.
records.notes: Batch traced to the transferred production location introduced by ECR-003.

records.measured_summary: Process capability index on press force below the specified minimum.
records.notes: Press-fit capability is a separate concern from the cure-related stiffness deviation.

records.measured_summary: Rig durability schedule completed with no crack initiation.
records.notes: Completed with incumbent-source bushings. Not representative of the transferred source.

records.measured_summary: Disc thickness variation exceeded the specified limit at 8200 km.
records.deviation: Thickness variation above limit before schedule completion
records.notes: Vehicle fitted with the revised low-copper friction compound from ECR-002.

records.measured_summary: Friction coefficient within band across most of the envelope; elevated scatter above 400 degC.
records.deviation: Scatter at high temperature not covered by the specified band definition
records.notes: The specified band does not define behaviour above 400 degC.

records.measured_summary: Fade and recovery performance met the applicable approval requirement.
records.notes: Approval requirement satisfied with the revised compound.

records.measured_summary: Cold performance stopping distance met the applicable approval requirement.
records.notes: Approval requirement satisfied with the revised compound.

records.measured_summary: Restricted substance content within the permitted level on all analysed samples.
records.notes: Confirms the regulatory driver for ECR-002 is satisfied.

records.measured_summary: Noise occurrence rate above the defined limit, concentrated in humid low speed conditions.
records.notes: Revised compound shows higher squeal propensity.

records.measured_summary: Continuous power reduced below target at 11 minutes into the sustained gradient.
records.deviation: Power below target before the thermal limit was reached
records.notes: Inverter derate engaged earlier than the defined onset threshold.

records.measured_summary: Derate onset measured 9 K below the defined junction temperature threshold.
records.notes: Directly supports the calibration hypothesis addressed by ECR-004.

records.measured_summary: Rolling resistance of the 255/45R20 specification above the energy budget allocation.
records.notes: Measured against the allocation defined for the 19 inch specification.

records.measured_summary: Wheel and tyre assembly mass above the unsprung mass allocation on the 20 inch specification.
records.notes: Both wheel and tyre contribute to the increase.

records.measured_summary: Vertical ride acceleration above the comfort target on two of three reference surfaces.
records.notes: Vehicle fitted with the 20 inch specification.
Pass-by noise not yet measured with the 20 inch tyre specification. Regulatory evidence gap.
Axle load and load index verification not yet repeated after the proposed mass changes.

records.measured_summary: Certified combined range measured at 498 km.
records.notes: Measured on the 19 inch specification. Not representative of the 20 inch variant.

records.measured_summary: Kerb mass measured at 2085 kg.
records.notes: Measured before the proposed 12V relocation and wheel change.

records.measured_summary: Sectioning of the affected production week showed braze coverage below minimum on 2 of 5 samples with through-wall porosity on 1.
records.deviation: Coverage below minimum and porosity present
records.notes: Samples drawn from the production week affected by the ECR-010 furnace change.

records.measured_summary: Gauge study indicated measurement system capability inadequate at the specified leak rate limit.
records.notes: Detection capability concern compounds the process concern.

records.measured_summary: Helium leak test passed on 100 sampled plates from the requalified production.
records.notes: Post-containment sample. Does not clear the originally affected population.

records.measured_summary: Flatness within specified tolerance on all measured plates.
Assist response time measured outside the specified time constant on the prototype ECU.
records.notes: Prototype ECU fitted with the successor microcontroller proposed in ECR-011.
Diagnostic coverage analysis for the successor device has not been performed. Safety evidence gap for an ASIL D requirement.

records.measured_summary: Safe state entered for every injected fault with manual steerability retained.
records.notes: Performed on the incumbent microcontroller. Not transferable to the successor device.

records.measured_summary: Cell voltage spread converged below the limit within the specified duration after the algorithm update.
records.notes: Effectiveness verification for CA-001.

records.measured_summary: Protection engaged within the specified response time at the defined threshold.
Monitored sensor tracked the hottest reference thermocouple within 3 K under moderate load; deviation grew to 7 K under sustained high load.
records.deviation: Error band under sustained high load not defined in the acceptance criterion
records.notes: Relevant to the thermal derate investigation. Sensor representativeness degrades exactly in the condition under investigation.

records.measured_summary: Usable energy measured at 78.6 kWh.
records.notes: Measured on the current 68Ah cell. Not representative of the proposed 75Ah cell.
Accelerated ageing durability not started for the revised chemistry. Acceptance criterion also TBD.

records.measured_summary: Maximum cell to cell temperature difference measured at 5.1 K.
records.notes: Measured at 25 degC coolant inlet. No mapping at elevated coolant inlet temperature.

records.measured_summary: HVAC energy consumption above the allocated budget with the 7cc compressor.
records.notes: Directly relevant to the ECR-005 trade-off.

records.measured_summary: Cabin cool-down achieved within the defined time with the 7cc compressor.
records.notes: ECR-005 achieves its primary objective.

records.measured_summary: Cabin noise above the defined level at two compressor speeds.
records.notes: Side effect of the larger compressor.

records.measured_summary: Transferred level above the defined limit in the 40 to 80 Hz band on coarse surfaces.
records.deviation: Above limit in the target band
records.notes: Driver for ECR-012.

records.measured_summary: Range estimate error outside the defined band at ambient temperatures below 5 degC.
records.deviation: Error outside band at low ambient

records.measured_summary: Bus utilisation exceeded the defined maximum under worst-case loading.
records.notes: Additional charge control signals were introduced without a bus load reassessment.

records.measured_summary: Supply voltage fell below the specified band during simultaneous peak demand.
records.notes: Measured with the proposed rear 12V battery location.

records.measured_summary: Aged catalyst emissions above the applicable limits on 2 of 3 samples with the reduced loading.
records.notes: Directly challenges the ECR-013 cost proposal.

records.measured_summary: Light-off time longer than the defined time on the reduced loading formulation.
Emissions within the applicable approval limits.
records.notes: Measured on the current catalyst formulation, not the reduced loading proposal.

records.measured_summary: Compression set beyond the qualification limit on 2 of 8 samples after accelerated thermal cycling.
Cell voltage sense signal dropout observed on 3 channels during the vibration profile.
Open state not confirmed on 1 of 6 units after repeated high current interruption.
records.notes: Safety critical. Containment in place.

records.measured_summary: Specified cycle count completed without welding.
records.notes: Performed on the main contactor, not the DC charge contactor pair.

records.measured_summary: No unintended torque exceeding the safe limit for any injected fault.
records.notes: Performed on calibration INV-4.0.2, superseded by INV-4.1.7 and the proposed v4.2.
Penetration testing not yet performed for the current interface set.
